mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(duration), 0) FROM time_entry WHERE issue_id = #{issueId} AND ongoing = false
mapper.update: UPDATE issue i SET spent_hours = COALESCE( (SELECT ROUND(SUM(te.duration) / 60.0, 2) FROM time_entry te WHERE te.issue_id = i.id AND te.ongoing = false), 0 ) WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT t.id, t.issue_id, t.project_id, t.user_id, t.logged_by, t.work_date, t.duration, t.start_time, t.description, t.ongoing, t.created_at, t.updated_at, i.issue_key, i.title AS issue_title, CASE WHEN i.id IS NULL OR i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN true ELSE false END AS issue_deleted, u.display_name AS user_name, lb.display_name AS logged_by_name, wiav.name AS work_type, wiav.id AS work_type_id, wiav.color AS work_type_color FROM time_entry t LEFT JOIN issue i ON i.id = t.issue_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user lb ON lb.id = t.logged_by AND t.logged_by != t.user_id LEFT JOIN time_entry_attribute_value teav ON teav.time_entry_id = t.id AND teav.attribute_id = #{workTypeAttributeId} LEFT JOIN work_item_attribute_value wiav ON wiav.id = teav.value_id WHERE t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.work_date >= #{startDate} AND t.work_date <= #{endDate} AND (t.ongoing = false OR t.user_id = #{currentUserId}) ORDER BY t.work_date ASC, t.start_time ASC, t.created_at ASC
